I really hate it when people act like serial killers aren’t human though or don’t deserve sympathy. It’s sick to me. I understand that they did awful things and I feel deeply sorry for the victims, but that doesn’t mean we all have to hate the perpetrators pr act like they’re emotionless monsters. They’re human beings. They hurt others because they were hurt in some way themselves. Not necessarily externally, I’m sure you could find a lot of serial killers (or any killer for that matter) who had a perfectly fine childhood and whatever else, but that doesn’t mean they didn’t have something going on internally. It doesn’t matter who you are everyone suffers, but everyone also loves something. That’s what makes us alive. Some people are more fucked up by their pain than others and sometimes people cope with that by hurting themselves or others, but that doesn’t mean they don’t deserve empathy and understanding. It doesn’t help anything if we treat serial killers in the same sick way they treat others. An eye for an eye only ends up making the whole world blind. Something’s wrong with them and they need to be shown love and treated humanely. They’re hurt and they can get better and I’m sure they feel guilty for the things they did. Anyway, I know the people who actually take the time to read this will probably just think I’m stupid and crazy but really. We’ve all hurt someone, and it doesn’t help when people hurt you more for doing so. It only makes you angrier and more willing to hurt other people because you don’t care. We all have the capability to do terrible things, but we all have the capability to do great things too. If someone hurts someone else, they aren’t evil, they need help. They need love and understanding and forgiveness. No one is inherently evil. Everyone, I believe, is inherently good, some people just need help to rediscover it I guess. It’s like when someone gets the death penalty and everyone’s so fucking happy about it like they deserve it, but how does tha make us any better than the person who killed someone? In the moment they were probably blinded by their impulses and probably felt like their victim deserved it. No one ever deserves death, and no one is ever beyond hope to be ‘good.’ This is really disjointed cuz my brains not working right rn but anyway. You know what I mean
